title: Mouse button lock needs excluded applications !

judgment.rationale: The request identifies Mouse Button Lock interference in games and asks for exclusions or a toggle, but does not identify a game or the button gesture that fails.
evidence: The report requests an application exclusion list or global shortcut, but contains no game name, affected mouse button, hold duration or expected in-game action.

Current MouseButtonLockCore.h and dllmain.cpp implement global button state/transition handling. The report does not yet distinguish intended ClickLock activation from an unrelated dropped-input defect.
Search found the original feature PR #49279 and configuration/triage work, but no direct PR referencing #52145.
judgment.recommended_action: Collect one concrete game/button sequence, then evaluate an exclusion gate that safely releases any latched button when the foreground application changes.

proposed_fixes.root_cause: Global locking can interpret normal gameplay button holds as latch gestures; an exclusion gate may be needed, but the report does not yet establish the exact failing gesture.
plan: Use a named game and button sequence to confirm locking causes the lost input.
Add normalized process exclusions integrated with module settings and foreground changes; release any synthetic held state before bypassing excluded input.
Test entering/leaving excluded games during a latched press, module disable, and elevated foreground applications.
verification: Verify ordinary desktop ClickLock still works and excluded game input passes through with no stuck button.

comment.body: Thanks for identifying Mouse Button Lock as the feature interfering with your games. Could you name one affected game, the mouse button enabled in Mouse Button Lock, your configured hold duration, and the exact press/hold/release sequence that fails? Please also confirm whether disabling only Mouse Button Lock restores that same in-game action. This distinguishes expected locking from a separate dropped-input problem and gives us a test case for an application exclusion.
